observed_model_label_basis: D068's 47 successful jev-latest responses reported jev-1.13.0 (14), typesafe-ai/jev (30), and typesafe/jev-1.13-20260917 (3). These historically observed labels are accepted under the documented Jev 1.13 assumption; a generic provider label does not independently prove the underlying model version.

local_limit_interpretation.basis: Decimal interpretation below any 65536/32768 interpretation; the official labels do not specify the meaning of k. These are thresholds for local estimates, not measured token counts.

estimator.request_scope: The exact compact JSON bytes returned by prepareDecision, including the complete state, all questions, type, instructions, criteria and JSON envelope.
estimator.single_question_scope: The sum of JSON.stringify(state) UTF-8 bytes and the largest JSON.stringify(question) UTF-8 byte count. All question fields accepted by prepareDecision participate.
estimator.basis: Conservative local sizing policy for the observed English structured workload; the ratio and 512-token allowance are engineering assumptions. Historical aggregate usage coverage does not validate per-question context size.

admission_semantics: admit_estimated permits an attempt under this local policy only. It does not guarantee provider acceptance, actual token limits, decision quality or charge. A blocked request must be changed and reassessed before any POST; this module never retries or truncates.
request_binding: Bind the assessment to its canonical request SHA-256 and policy SHA-256; recheck immediately before POST. An explicitly observed resolved model label outside the documented/historically observed allowlist invalidates this policy.

sources.scope: Hosted Jev aliases and the two model-context constraints.
